title: 12D workbench visual language constraints
clauseOfficialized: 12D workbench visual language: four collaboration zones plus session sidebar; touch targets at least 48 logical pixels; WCAG AA text contrast 4.5:1; type scale 200% keeps confirm/cancel hittable; errors are not color-only; reduced motion stops autoplay and flicker preview and does not strip program motion; progress is phase-only; a late result must not steal focus.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: The art-design plan noted that 12D had a11y constraints but no independent workbench visual-language chapter, type scale, or palette contract.
rowsStillOpenOnI025: Restore last durable edit (remaining acceptance unchanged)
